free_tier.stated: Every account gets a free monthly allowance, shown in the dashboard; AI requests per 10 s are 20 for an anonymous (guest) account, 30 for a free account and 200 for a paid one
free_tier.notes: the size of the monthly allowance is not stated on the pages read: unverified

tooling: Puter.js, puter.ai.chat(prompt, {model}) from a browser or Node.js; there are no API keys, and each user's own Puter account carries the cost. A REST route for a non-browser client was not read
chaining: pairs with browser apps; the cost lands on the signed-in or guest account, not on a developer key

limits.value: AI requests per 10 s: 20 anonymous, 30 free, 200 paid; concurrent AI requests: 2 anonymous, 3 free, 20 paid

binding_note: the guest-account ceiling of 20 requests per 10 s and 2 concurrent binds; the monthly credit is a second, unquantified gate

identity_cost.detail: unverified: the rate-limit page names an anonymous tier that is a temporary (guest) account, and the tutorial says users authenticate with their Puter account; whether a guest account can spend the monthly allowance on chat, and what a full signup collects, were not read

reliability_note: a call that runs out of credit answers 402 insufficient_funds and the SDK shows the user an upgrade prompt
confidence_note: all values are from first-party documentation; no request was sent to a Puter endpoint

evidence.quote: Puter.js uses the [User-Pays model](https://docs.puter.com/user-pays-model/), where users authenticate with their Puter account and cover their own AI costs.
evidence.proved: AI calls are made under each user's Puter account with no developer API key

evidence.quote: - Every user starts with a free monthly allowance, enough to test out the platform and use apps built with Puter.js.
evidence.proved: every user has a free monthly allowance, with no number given

evidence.quote: Where a table shows three numbers, they are **paid / free / anonymous**. Paid is any subscription tier. Anonymous is a temporary (guest) account.
evidence.proved: anonymous means a temporary guest account
AI requests per 10 s are 200 paid, 30 free and 20 anonymous
concurrent AI requests are 20 paid, 3 free and 2 anonymous
